MPPSC Assistant Town Planner ATP Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) has released the admit card for the post of Assistant Town Planner (ATP). This recruitment was released for 39 posts. Online applying process for MPPSC Assistant Town Planner ATP Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 01 July 2026 to 31 July 2026. The written examination is going to conducted on 20 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their MPPSC Assistant Town Planner ATP Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Out : 02 February 2026
  • Application Start Date : 01 July 2026
  • Last Date : 31 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 July 2026
  • Correction Date : 05 July 2026 to 02 August 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 20 September 2026
  • Pre Admit Card : 10 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 500/-
  • MP Reserve Category : Rs. 250/-
  • PH (Divyang) : Rs. 250/-
  • Portal Charges : Rs. 40/- (Included)
  • Correction Charges : Rs. 50/- (Extra)
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
